basis: Public pay-as-you-go API list price for the model, in effect on the run date, applied to the tested agent's recorded tokens. It estimates what the run would cost through the provider's API, not what the harness subscription or a free tier actually charged.

gpt-5.6-luna.label: GPT-5.6 Luna
gpt-5.6-luna.note: Price after OpenAI's July 30, 2026 cut; all Luna runs are from August. Reproduces the costs OMP and PI recorded for Luna OMP and Luna PI.

gpt-5.6-sol.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
gpt-5.6-sol.note: Standard rate before August 21, 2026; reproduces the cost OMP recorded for Sol OMP.

periods.note: From August 21, 2026 OpenAI's promotional rate applies, at least through November 21, 2026; cache writes are 1.25x input.

gpt-5.6-terra.label: GPT-5.6 Terra
gpt-5.6-terra.note: Cache writes are billed at 1.25x uncached input. Requests with more than 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input and 1.5x output; T3 records only whole-turn totals, so the estimate is a lower bound.

gpt-6-luna.label: GPT-6 Luna
gpt-6-luna.note: Standard tier. Requests with more than 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output; T3 records only whole-turn totals, so the estimate is a lower bound.

gpt-6.1-sol.label: GPT-6.1 Sol
gpt-6.1-sol.note: Standard tier. Requests with more than 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output; T3 records only whole-turn totals, so the estimate is a lower bound.

gpt-6.1-terra.label: GPT-6.1 Terra
gpt-6.1-terra.note: Standard tier, checked 2026-10-26. Cache writes are the 30-minute rate. Requests with more than 272K input tokens are billed at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output; T3 records only whole-turn totals, so the estimate is a lower bound.

deepseek-v4-flash.label: DeepSeek V4 Flash
deepseek-v4-flash.note: DeepSeek direct rates (cache hits 98% below input). Reproduces the cost OMP recorded for this run.

deepseek-v4.1-flash.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
deepseek-v4.1-flash.note: Off-peak rate. Weekday peak hours (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC) cost double; the October 24, 2026 runs ran on a Saturday, which is off-peak all day.

claude-opus-5-5.label: Claude Opus 5.5
claude-opus-5-5.note: Cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate; at the 1-hour rate ($8) this run would cost about $0.22 more.

claude-haiku-5-5.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
claude-haiku-5-5.note: Priced at the rate for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, with cache writes at the 5-minute rate. Requests whose prompt exceeds 100,000 tokens are billed at five times these prices ($0.50 / $0.625 / $0.05 / $2.50); T3 records only whole-turn totals, so the estimate is a lower bound.

claude-sonnet-5-5.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate; the 1-hour rate is $4.

gemini-4-argon-contributor.label: Gemini 4 Argon
gemini-4-argon-contributor.note: Introductory rate in effect on the run date (through November 30, 2026; $4 / $20 after). The run used the contributor variant; the public Gemini 4 Argon price is used.

muse-spark-1.3-contributor.label: Muse Spark 1.3
muse-spark-1.3-contributor.note: No cached-input price is published, so cached tokens are priced as regular input: an upper bound. The run used the contributor variant, listed at $0.10 / $0.20; the standard Muse Spark 1.3 price is used.

longcat-2.5-preview-free.label: LongCat 2.5 Preview
longcat-2.5-preview-free.note: The run used OpenCode's free variant; the paid API rate (a limited-time launch price) is used.

qwen3.8-max.label: Qwen3.8 Max
qwen3.8-max.note: International (Singapore) rate, one tier up to 1M tokens; thinking output costs the same. No cache-hit price is published, so cached tokens are priced as regular input: an upper bound. Explicit cache creation is 125% of input per Alibaba's context-cache documentation.

qwen3.8-flash.label: Qwen3.8 Flash
qwen3.8-flash.note: International (Singapore) rate, one tier up to 1M tokens. No cache-hit or cache-creation price is published, so cached tokens are priced as regular input: an upper bound.

mimo-v2.6-flash.label: MiMo-V2.6-Flash
mimo-v2.6-flash.note: Overseas real-time rate, checked 2026-10-26. Cache writes are free for a limited time.

glm-5.3-flash-free.label: GLM-5.3-Flash
glm-5.3-flash-free.note: The runs used OpenCode's free variant; Z.ai's paid list rate is used. Cached-input storage is free for a limited time.

nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free.label: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free.note: The run used OpenRouter's free variant; the paid OpenRouter rate is used. No cached-input price is listed, so cached tokens are priced as regular input: an upper bound.

beam-free.label: Beam
beam-free.unpriced: Free model on OpenCode with no public per-token price.

space-bunny.label: Space Bunny
space-bunny.unpriced: Anonymous stealth model offered free on OpenCode and OpenRouter; no public per-token price.
